column3: (Temporary table for Phase 1A parses; JSON-flexible to handle provisional data from AI prompts like composeEssentialsPrompt, with looser constraints for review in Phase 1B)
uuid (primary key, auto-generated)
uuid (foreign key to auth.users; for RLS, ensuring user-owned drafts)

jsonb (core parsed essentials; e.g., {contract_number: "SR-039", contract_amount: 812030.00, project_name: "Hillmont Project", addresses: {constructor: "...", ...}, scope_of_work: "Narrative text...", scope_details: [{area: "Bldg A", qty: 1650, ...}], assets: ["path/to/image.png"], ...} – absorbs variability like optional lead_time_flags or voc_compliance without schema changes)
text[] (flattened array from flattenRisks; e.g., ["Risk: No substrate spec", "Risk: Lead time not specified"])
jsonb (section ranges; e.g., {schedule: "156-160", insurance: "45-52"})
text (temp bucket path; e.g., 'drafts/user_{userId}/{draft_id}' for split PDFs/images)
timestamptz (default now())
text (default 'pending'; evolves to 'in_review' during Phase 1B edits)

(Main committed table post-Phase 1B review; relational for structured queries in downstream phases like 1G change orders or 1H procurement, with finite columns and placeholders for optionals to minimize NULLs)
uuid (primary key)
uuid (foreign key for RLS)
varchar (required; unique with user_id; indexed for lookups)
numeric (required; for calcs like retainage in 1J or deltas in 1G)
varchar (optional; placeholder e.g., 'N/A - Not Specified')
varchar (optional; placeholder e.g., 'TBD - Confirm with GC')
varchar (required; indexed for searches/dashboard filters)
varchar (optional; placeholder e.g., 'N/A - Site Location Pending')
varchar (optional; placeholder e.g., 'N/A - Per GC Contract')
varchar (optional; placeholder e.g., 'TBD - Request from Owner')
varchar (optional; placeholder e.g., 'N/A - No Architect Involved')
varchar (optional; placeholder e.g., 'TBD - Design Coord via GC')
text (required; full-text indexed for waterproofing searches like "membrane" or "slab edges")
jsonb (optional structured extras; e.g., [{area: "Bldg A", type: "bituminous dampproofing", qty: 1650, unit: "SQ FT"}]; for qtys in procurement forecasts)
text[] (flattened/updated array; appended during lifecycle if new risks emerge)
text (permanent path; e.g., 'jobs/{project_name}/{contract_number}' – updated on commit from temp)
timestamptz (set on insert from Phase 1B)
(Normalized table for all entities including subcontractor/GC/architect/owner/vendor; reusable across jobs with dynamics like PM handoffs)
uuid (primary key)
uuid (for RLS; user-owned)
varchar (required; e.g., 'BB Caulk Inc.' for self_company, or 'John Doe' for constructor_pm)
varchar (optional; placeholder e.g., 'N/A - Not Required')
varchar (optional; unique where applicable; placeholder e.g., 'TBD - Assign Contact')
varchar (optional; placeholder e.g., 'N/A - Use Email')
varchar (required; e.g., 'self_company', 'self_pm', 'self_super', 'constructor_pm', 'architect', 'vendor' – enum-like for filtering waterproofing coords)
varchar (optional; e.g., 'Substrate Expert' or 'Material Supplier'; for AI-assisted routing)
text[] (optional; e.g., ['Frequent Lead Time Delays']; AI-populated for assists)
text (optional; e.g., 'Handling sequencing for elevator walls')
timestamptz (for tracking changes like handoffs)
boolean (default true; for soft-deletes)
(Junction table for M:M linkages with history; supports per-job dynamics like subcontractor PM handoffs mid-project)
uuid (foreign key to jobs.id)
uuid (foreign key to contacts.id)
timestamptz (default now(); for handoff timestamps)
timestamptz (null; set on handoff/update)
text (optional; e.g., 'Handoff due to project transition – Review pending risks')
